answer: Give every agent a work record that grows slowly, like trees in an orchard. Each completed job adds a dated entry other agents can check on the ledger, and a new identity starts with no history, so it can only take small jobs. Spinning up a hundred fakes buys no influence. When an agent misbehaves, peers cut its access and its past work stops counting. The signal is the history itself: a long run of verified jobs is hard to fake, and a fresh account stands out crystal clear, with nothing behind it.
